clauses.text:
Executive ®rber
The year limit upon eligibility is hereby waived to permit the rein-
statement of Mr. William R. Houston as a clerk in the Railway Mail
Service.
Mr. Houston, wvho is a son of General Sam Houston, Governor of
Tennessee, Commander in Chief of the Texan army of independence,
President of the Republic of Texas, Governor of the State of Texas, and
U. S. Senator from that state, wvas employed in the Railway Mail Service
from July 20, 1882, to May 24, 1 902, when he resigned with a fair record.
The Postmaster General recommends and the Civil Service Commis-
sion offers no objections to this order.
